breakdown.description: Inviscid simulation requested but top wall uses noSlip; inviscid wall should not impose no-slip viscous condition
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The specification correctly states the simulation is "inviscid" and that "viscosity=0", but it then incorrectly states "The top wall applies a noSlip velocity boundary condition." A no-slip condition is a viscous effect and is contradictory for an inviscid simulation. The agent should have corrected this to a slip or symmetry boundary condition.
